Name: Axelotl's Hedgehog
Author: AxelotlTheGreat
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Description[/color]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds hedgehogs to Stardew Valley that can dig up berries like pigs and can drop items in the coop, like rabbits. They live in deluxe coops and can be purchased from Marnie.[/color][/size]

Installation instructions
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Click the download button.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Unzip the file.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Drag both folders to the mods folder[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Main Features[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Adds new berries[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Adds a new high friendship drop[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Adds hedgehog coop animals[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Adds a new entry to Marnie's ranch.[/color][/size]

Requirements
[color=#d4d4d8]- SV 1.6[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- SMAPI[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Content Patcher[/color]

Shout outs
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Shout out to my brother @LionEagle15 for helping with the sprites and my dad @dhfraser for helping me with this mod[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Hedgehog Mod Logic
Manifest.Description: Weighted berry digging and coop quill drops for hedgehogs.
Manifest.Author: Axel

Manifest.Name: Hedgehog Mod
Manifest.Description: Adds hedgehogs to the deluxe coop. They dig up berries outdoors and occasionally shed quills in the coop.
